skill.summary: Manage Ethereum wallets with encrypted keys, TOTP 2FA, secure ETH transactions, audit logs, and rate limiting for AI-driven payment processing.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Wallet Payment System skill.

- Enables secure creation and management of Ethereum wallets with military-grade encryption.
- Supports secure ETH transactions using Web3, with TOTP-based two-factor authentication.
- Provides encrypted key storage, password policies with high entropy, and backup/recovery options.
- Features built-in rate limiting, comprehensive audit logging, and abuse prevention tools.
- Includes command-line demo, API for integration with AI agents, and extensive configuration instructions.
